correctness.rationale: The explicit signed-increment decomposition gives alpha_N=1/2-tau/logN, v_N=12-8tau/logN, bounded martingale differences and exact conditional variances. The gamma-normalized martingale has predictable bracket converging uniformly to 12 Gamma(3/2)^2 integral_0^t exp(2tau u)du; its dependent correction is O(1/logN) in expectation via the proved exact second-moment recurrence and uniform log bound, while jumps satisfy Lindeberg. The functional martingale CLT and uniform gamma multiplier yield the OU limit; Doob L² control establishes tightness at time zero. An exact recurrence yields 12 F(tau) and the harmonic special case. Independently replayed script reports 2917 exact and 56 numerical diagnostics, not a substitute for analytic proof.
